_how_to_fill: 1. Open NSE's holidays page (nseindia.com > Resources > Exchange Communication > Holidays) or the circular titled 'Trading Holidays for the calendar year YYYY'.
2. Use the Equities / Capital Market segment list. Copy every holiday as {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "name": "..."} into 'holidays'. Weekends are refused anyway, so weekend holidays are optional.
3. Copy special sessions into 'special_sessions': Muhurat trading, a budget-day Saturday/Sunday session, any mock or DR session NSE announces. The toolkit refuses to trade them.
4. Put the circular's reference number and date in source["YYYY"].
5. Only when that year's list is complete, add the year to 'years_covered'. Until then every date in that year is refused.
Later circulars (an added holiday, a Muhurat time) must be added by hand too.
